bug_rca.root_cause: Bottom navigation button onClick handlers directly called setCurrentPage() which only updated React state but didn't trigger the flipbook library to actually change pages
bug_rca.fix_applied: Changed button handlers to use prevPage()/nextPage() functions which properly use goToPage() and handle both mobile mode (direct state) and desktop flipbook mode (library API)
bug_rca.verification: Tested clicking Next multiple times and verified page indicator, text content, and images all changed between pages
